author: neal_illustrator
title: Looking for artists to build comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! I’m so excited to have the team grow! I’m like a little studio now! Stay stellar!! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio is hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Looking for a place to grow in comics & illustration. OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Seeking people who are serious, consistent, and can work with a team. Send CV & Portfolio to: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Name – Position – CV & Portfolio). Open until all positions are filled.

author: willai3213
title: Seeking exhibition graphic designer including character visuals
content: [徵｜展覽平面設計專案合作] Preparing an exhibition at Huashan, Taipei in early December and looking for a graphic designer to collaborate on visual design. Scope: main visual, logotype, character visual design (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, one banner flag, other exhibition derivatives (hanging scrolls, panels), pre-press proofing and size checks. Timeline: early Oct first draft of main visual & type; mid Oct final; early Nov all output designs; mid Nov print; early Dec exhibition. Seeking someone with exhibition/graphic design experience, hand-drawn, Japanese-inspired, warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote. Contact: comment or DM @willai3213
